name: Investment Holdings
description: Accounts, owned positions, lots, quantities, acquisition costs, and investment transactions.
captureExamples: I bought ten shares of NVDA.
notes: Positions attach directly to Financial Accounts; ledger installation is optional. Watchlist interest is a separate fact and uses the same shared Instrument value schema.
